SELECT 
  SUM(net_sales) as total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) = 9

SELECT 
  MIN(business_date) as earliest_date,
  MAX(business_date) as latest_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as trading_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as store_count
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as september_trading_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as stores_in_september,
  COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) = 9

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  d.close_date,
  COUNT(*) as september_records
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
FULL OUTER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = true
LEFT JOIN dim_store d ON s.store_id = d.store_id AND d.close_date IS NOT NULL
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.business_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.business_date) = 9
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, d.close_date
ORDER BY s.store_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_rows,
  COUNT(net_sales) as non_null_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative_sales_rows
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) = 9

SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_from_fact_sales,
  SUM(r.refund_net) as total_refunds,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales_calculated
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9

SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) as regular_sales,
  COUNT(*) as regular_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9
  AND staff_purchase_flag = false

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.return_date) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.return_date) = 9 THEN refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns_in_sept,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9)
           AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.return_date) <> 2026 OR EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.return_date) <> 9)
           THEN refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns_from_sept_sales_returned_later
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2026 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9
  AND r.return_date IS NOT NULL
